description: Find a free stock photo by a keyword (Unsplash). Returns the image's URL and the author's metadata. Use it before update_cell to fill a url field with the 'display_as_image' option. Never call it automatically for all records — only on an explicit request, or with the user's confirmation for bulk.

query.description: Search query in English, e.g. 'red leather chair'

name: search_image
